decisions.statement: A page is asked for backward.
A cursor is the nanosecond the last page ended at.
A cursor is written in base64.
A page filling the limit exactly is read as a page with more behind.
Reading every page stops at four hundred pages rather than running forever.
A window reaching past Loki's retention is answered without asking Loki.
Asking which namespaces a pod has streams in answers nothing rather than refusing.
A label value is escaped before the value goes into a matcher.
Nothing here says why a result is short.

definition: the log lines Loki has for a pod, read newest first a page at a time
